c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Set the cycle flavor; the human picks, you may recommend. Later cycles seed from the ideas board's open threads. Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: Flavor: refine, continuing mechanisms+cleanup. Human picked the content directly: exc-8 spine-instructions prototype + inline 12-disagreement adjudication overview.

q1.title: Overview of the 12 issue-verdict disagreements for Tommy's adjudication
q1.imperative: From exc-4 and exc-5 artifacts (no new dispatch), lay out each of the 12 disagreements: what each pass said, the evidence each cited, and a recommendation. Deliver to Tommy in plain language. Record the summary as the finding.
q1.finding: 12-disagreement adjudication overview built from exc-4 + exc-5 evidence, one conflict re-verified by hand (#239: templates DO carry @grade, landed by 7c8ff1b which cites #239 — cold read correct, exc-4 wrong at HEAD). Recommendations: CLOSE 10 (239 244 296 336 337 338 347 349 364 374 — each with cold-read tree evidence: fix landed/test-pinned/graduated/captured-in-episode/refiled-sharper); RESCOPE 1 (#208: doctrine half done at admiral SKILL.md:70, mechanized harvest-completeness check still unbuilt — matches mechanization direction); RESOLVE-AS-DUP 1 (#278 -> #409: defect real and growing, 6 root notes files, keep the better-evidenced issue and fold the template fix in). Net: the two passes disagreed mostly because exc-4 judged titles/clusters while cold agents read comments and re-verified the tree; where they conflicted on tree facts, the cold read was right in the one case hand-checked. Presented to Tommy for adjudication — his call.

x8.title: Excursion exc-8-spine-instructions: prototype moving step-specific instructions into the spine
x8.imperative: Prototype excursion per EXCURSION_BRIEF exc-8-spine-instructions on the ideas board. Dispatches constellation-prototyper in a throwaway worktree; proof is a live demonstration that a relocated instruction reaches an agent through the engine's per-gate output while the always-loaded skill prose shrinks. Result lands at evidence/exc-8-spine-instructions-RESULT.md. Record the scoped verdict as the finding.
x8.finding: exc-8 ANSWERED-YES with one hard boundary and one cost (evidence/exc-8-spine-instructions-RESULT.md): a relocated instruction rides the gate imperative through current verbatim and a cold sonnet agent that never saw the skill prose acted on it correctly — round 2 discriminated cleanly (spine arm ran the check and rebuilt the removed template section; no-instruction arm did not). Census: 54.2% of Commander's true always-loaded words are step-specific/relocatable; SKILL.md itself is already 100% kernel (the overhead is in commander-core.md, 57% step-specific); 84% of relocatable words concentrate on just execute+plan. Boundary: bootstrap floor — instantiate-and-claim text can never ride the channel it creates. Cost: engine RAIL echoes the imperative verbatim = exact 2x per current call — fix the echo first or relocation inverts its own goal. Bonus defect found: gate anchors/constraints blocks are INVISIBLE to agents driving from current (all 5 cold agents independently hit it) — tracker-worthy, bears on #393. NOT tested: bulk relocation (dose-response named as next variant), other roles, shared-across-roles text, n=1 per arm. Worktree kept: C:/Programs/.proto-exc8-spine-instructions commit 5a283ad.

consolidation.summary: Cycle 3 complete: spine-instructions relocation PROVEN live (54% of Commander always-loaded words relocatable; bootstrap kernel + RAIL-echo fix + selective-not-wholesale are the design constraints; anchors-invisible defect discovered). 12-disagreement adjudication overview built and delivered: recommend close 10, rescope #208, resolve #278 as dup of #409; one contested tree fact hand-verified (cold read right). Both Arc-1 legs (governor, spine-instructions) now rest on live prototypes. Convergence remains Tommy's call.
